label: Douyin Shop Service Market (CN)
terms_note: ISV qualification + Douyin Shop developer agreement; Chinese entity typically required.

discovery.auth: app_key/app_secret (抖店开放平台 ISV 接入)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (抖店开放平台 ISV APIs — list software services to merchants; no bidding API). Lane `human` → **keep**. Confidence medium (r.jina.ai).
auth: 1. Register as 服务商 (ISV) → app_key / app_secret → 上架服务市场.

endpoints.call: 店铺API / 商品API / 库存API / 素材中心API
endpoints.purpose: merchant-side operations for the ISV's app

reference.limits: - Partner qualification; Chinese company; platform agreement. - ISV qualification + Douyin Shop developer agreement; Chinese entity typically required.

reason: The 抖店开放平台 (https://op.jinritemai.com/docs/guide-docs/10/23, opened 2026-09-25) serves registered ISV apps only: every call carries app_key + a merchant-authorised access_token and a signature over sorted param_json with a GMT+8 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss' timestamp. The service-market side lets an ISV read orders for services merchants bought from it; there is no endpoint that lists open merchant demand to bid on, so nothing maps to search_postings/submit_bid, and access requires ISV onboarding.
